title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound! — Episode6 It Will Pay Off Someday

meta.Episode: Episode6 — It Will Pay Off Someday
meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Line: Wind Instrument Booth

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What do we do?
The convention's gonna end soon!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What am I doing wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't say for certain, since I've only been practicing for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But as far as I can tell, you don't appear to be blowing too hard or holding your lips incorrectly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Which means there must be another reason.
All we have to do is figure out what that is...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All we can do is keep trying as many different things as we can...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's make good use of every second that we have left! I'll do my best to help, too!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I doubt there's any point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I still can't play, despite all the help you guys are giving me...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I don't think I'm cut out for this, after all.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But I'm glad I tried.
Thank you all...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please wait.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand why you feel like giving up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But... That's exactly why I don't want you to.
I know this is very selfish of me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mentioned how you struggle to produce a good sound, despite your best efforts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The truth is, I've experienced something very similar.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Huh...?
You have?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
But it wasn't the trumpet in my case.
It was the piano and the violin...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as you're struggling now, I had a lot of trouble producing the sound I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That ideal sound... No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't reach it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt just as frustrated as you are at the moment. Every time I failed, I felt like crying, because it was a reminder of my lack of skill and talent.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't remember how many times I wanted to give up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, after a year or two of practicing, my sound began improving.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was subtle, but I started getting closer to that ideal sound I had in my head.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
Again, it was very subtle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But that made me so happy...
Even though I still had to endure some very hard practices, I couldn't stop playing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And each time I put in an honest effort, my music changed for the better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I could play even more beautifully than I had imagined.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If any part of you still wishes to produce beautiful music, then I implore you to not give up here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because you will be able to... Someday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Then, I'll keep trying for a bit longer...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, let's keep trying together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That desire to play beautiful music...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, let's give it another try.
Would you mind showing me again how you're buzzing your lips?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Okay!
se_event_beautifulsound_2024_015
se_event_beautifulsound_2024_015

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That sound you just made...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I did it...!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yoisaki?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That discussion you just had about wanting to play beautiful music reminded me of something I learned when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: About how important it is to have a clear mental image.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A clear mental image?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Even with good technique, it's possible to become so overly conscious of your playing that things stop working.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which is why it can be helpful to take a step back, clear your mind and focus only on the sound you wish to produce.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The sound you wish to produce...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I fell into the very same trap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Compared to when I was just practicing to get better, I always seemed to produce a much better sound when I focused on playing like Dad...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, if he does what Yoisaki says and really focuses on what he wants, then he'll be able to play properly?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes!
Let's give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Okay!
